items.title: fresh verifier for the whole of gate G2
items.task: Fresh verifier for the whole of gate G2 of this track (checklist item C18; decision 0016 item 4; coord/DECISIONS/0046 item 1). About ninety minutes, processors only, no card run. At your start launch `harness/bin/nrpic-stage verify A-emd-pbh G2 --full` detached in the background from this worktree (log under scratch/A-emd-pbh/tmp/; it reads every output once and may take hours; do not wait for it; say in your report that it runs and where its log is; keep your own work to two or three cores meanwhile). Trust nothing and do not read the lead's verdicts first (the outcome entries of the journals, stage/REVIEW-wave3.md, the verdict column of stage/G2/CHECKLIST.md): take what is claimed from stage/G2/RERUN.md, stage/G2/VERIFY and Table V of the note, the criteria from scope/SCOPE.md, the predictions as they were written before the runs (git log shows when). An earlier verifier covered the numbers of conv_ball and threshold_ball (stage/G2/VERIFIER-C18.md, with the lead's answers in threshold_ball/JOURNAL.md entry 12): spot-check two of those and spend the time on what was added since, with readers of your own, each tested on an analytic case first: (1) the Szekeres series (64, 128, 256 cells): your own exact reference, the orders of convergence between the members at tau 10 to 30, the error against the non-spherical signal, where each member stops; (2) the triaxial runs S1L and S1L-h (half amplitude): the first shell crossing with a measure that does not depend on the shift, the Zel'dovich reference from a derivation of your own, the Newtonian controls, and whether the band of prediction A2H was met; say plainly that test A2 failed as written; (3) the periodic chain P0L6: the shells against the exact solution outside r0 = 1.5 (the lead: 1 to 4 per cent), and from horizon_status_0.txt the false acceptance at t = 118.1 and the stall from t = 136; (4) item C3: the ratio of the Hamiltonian constraint to 16 pi E outside the horizon for the top hat and the smoothed members on the two meshes at t = 0 and t = 0.25 to 1, the orders of convergence, the member with eight particles per cell; (5) every row of Table V of the note that you did not reach above: at least its run id exists and its number is in the run's registered output. A prediction before each recomputation, the outcome after it. Per claim: reproduced (to how many digits), not reproduced, or not checkable and why; items and predictions that failed as written are stated as failed (C3, A2, the horizon part of C1 (ii), and the others the package lists). Figures you look at. Write stage/G2/VERIFIER.md; only after it is written, a last section that compares with the lead's verdicts.

items.extra: Extra for this session: a SHORT one, about forty-five minutes. Rulings: coord/DECISIONS/0046 item 2. (1) Close the analysis B-20261126-212212-c54d979 if it has ended and judge GM2 and GM3 (registered compare_legs.py, figure looked at); C2, C11, the paragraph and ledger row in note section VI. (2) Item C1: design the shearing-dust run free of stream crossing at three meshes (the amplitude below which no stream crosses within the comparison time, from the exact solution or a processor test), write the prediction (the value converges toward the reference code's within what tolerance, and what would refute it) and run it: on processors where it fits, at most one card-hour through the shared queue at priority 2 on the release build. The case as run stays failed on record. (3) Item C3: the member of 64 cells at eight particles per cell (the member of 128 cells exists), prediction first (the factor by which the mean constraints fall between 64 and 128 cells at fixed sampling, and what would refute convergence), priority 2. (4) HANDOFF with the queue ids and how each is read; commit, push. No stage package in this session.
